sees: frame 1: Two rows on a pale panel, labeled JACK (top) and AUGUST (bottom). Each row has a yellow-circled notepad icon labeled NOTES on the left and a battery/gauge icon labeled VICIOUS on the right. Both gauges are about one third full. Badge top-left reads 'INSIGHT 2 / 2', badge top-right reads 'WONDER'.

frame 2: A curved arrow now runs from each NOTES icon to its VICIOUS gauge. In the JACK row the gauge has dropped to nearly empty, with a dashed line above the fill. In the AUGUST row the gauge has risen to about three quarters full, above a dashed line.
frame 3: Same as frame 2. The arrows are in place, JACK's VICIOUS gauge is almost empty and AUGUST's is mostly full.
changed: The notes icons are no longer highlighted by a full ring. Arrows appeared from notes to the gauges. In the Jack row the VICIOUS level went down to almost nothing. In the August row it went up to nearly full.
cause: The notes, shown by the arrows, seem to drive the VICIOUS level. The same notes lower it for Jack and raise it for August.
effect: The same notes lead to opposite results: Jack ends up not vicious and August ends up very vicious.
message: The same notes make Jack less vicious but August far more vicious, so how the notes are used or read shifts the outcome in opposite directions.
wouldConfuse: It is unclear what the notes contain or why they affect the two people differently. The gauge labeled VICIOUS could be read as a battery level. The dashed line is unexplained, perhaps the starting level. The scene gives no reason for the opposite effects.
